description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for managing firmware upgrades, including file installation, hook execution, device identification, partition reading, and firmware flashing, used in embedded Linux systems.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to a RAM root, creating symlinks for symbolic links and copying regular files if they do not exist.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs an executable binary and its dependencies.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no answer with a default.

methods.name: _v
methods.description: Logs verbose messages if VERBOSE is set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a timestamped message and sends it to syslog.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads a file or device, optionally decompressing based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Reads image data with dd, piping through get_image.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Gets the magic word (file signature) of a file.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Gets a longer magic signature of a file.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads GPT partition table signature.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads VFAT filesystem signature.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads FAT32 filesystem signature.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies file type based on magic signature.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks for EFI partition magic.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks for FAT or FAT32 magic.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Identifies and exports the boot device based on root partition info.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports the partition device based on major/minor device numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts little-endian 32-bit hex to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table from a device and outputs partition info.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to upgrade.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by writing image to MTD partition, with cache drop and optional backup.
